statement: All continuous local H section classes over K_q, modulo geometric conjugacy, are computed. The invariants a,c are retained, while b,d normalize uniquely modulo3(q-1). Nonzero first inertia is the finite two-row Smith system of E.42. For zero first inertia and integral r=b/(q-1), all classes have unique centered-Dirac representatives indexed by the full product of Z3 over j>=0 and units mod3^v3(q-1). For nonintegral r and c=0, all classes have the explicit finite-rank representatives q(1-T^b), T^i-1, i=1,...,3^v3(b)-1; c nonzero gives no class. The exact weighted-integral quotient maps, their kernels, actual topology and all geometric conjugacies are proved.
notes: This computes the actual inherited arithmetic quotient H=3Z3 semidirect(3,U)Z3[[U]], with the exact quotient maps and kernels of E.38. In the zero-first-inertia case the residual conjugation operator is D_b=qT^b psi_q-1 on U Lambda. Integral r gives a measure decomposition into free q-orbits accumulating at0, and a product of orbit cokernels Z3. The centered measure series converges in the (3,U)-adic/profinite topology, not in the U-adic topology alone. Nonintegral r gives3^v3(b) free affine orbits; the exact augmentation lattice has sum divisible byq-1 and the displayed explicit basis. Full conjugation formulas prove unique b,d normalization and residual U Lambda action. The program verifies48 finite Smith systems,36 actual weighted-integral and group-ring transition maps, representative generation and topology; complete selected modular transformations are retained. The intrinsic lifting problem remains connected through the actual E.38 quotient maps and E.44 criteria; no surjectivity on intrinsic section classes is asserted.
